```{r setup, include=FALSE}
values <- sample(10:99, sample(3:7, 1))
while (all(values %% 2 == 0) || all(values %% 2 != 0)) {
  values <- sample(10:99, length(values))
}
correct <- values %% 2 == 0
```

Question
========
Select the even numbers. The values are `r paste(values, collapse = ", ")`.

Answerlist
----------
```{r choices, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
writeLines(paste("*", values))
```

Solution
========
Even numbers are divisible by two.

Answerlist
----------
```{r explanations, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
writeLines(paste("*", ifelse(correct, "Even.", "Odd.")))
```

Meta-information
================
exname: Random even numbers
extype: mchoice
exsolution: `r paste(as.integer(correct), collapse = "")`
